prompt: Character turnaround sheet for 3D modeling and rigging: the same character shown three times side by side, evenly spaced with wide gaps, not overlapping: front view, side view (facing left), back view, all orthographic and the same height. Keep the exact design, colours and outfit of the character in the attached front concept. The character: an adult Rootwarden treetender, a broad, stocky near-human about 1.6 m tall with bark-grained oak-wood skin in warm brown, amber eyes, pointed ears, two small teal crystal inlays in the brow, a low crown of short gnarled twigs with a few leaves on the head, moss, lichen and small white flowers growing on the shoulders, and a short rounded beard of moss with small white flowers ending at the upper chest. Outfit: rounded carved pale stone shoulder plates with leaf motifs over a fitted brown leather jerkin, a deep green cloth sash across the chest, a wide brown leather belt with a round carved gold-and-stone buckle, fitted dark green-brown trousers tucked into leather wraps, and bare root-like wooden feet. Rigging A-pose: standing straight, arms straight and angled 45 degrees down and out from the body with a clear gap between each arm and the torso all the way to the armpit, elbows straight, hands open and flat with palms facing forward, all five fingers spread wide apart with a visible gap between every finger, the thumb clearly separated and pointing away from the palm, slightly oversized hands with thick fingers, legs straight with feet shoulder-width apart and a clear gap between the thighs, feet flat pointing forward, head facing forward. No thin geometry: straps, ropes and trims are thick and solid, detail is painted into the surfaces. Clothing is fitted close to the body; nothing hangs loose between the legs or below the hips except as described. Full body, fully visible, nothing cut off by the edge. Hand-painted stylized game art, mid-level detail, chunky readable shapes, softer muted colours. Plain light grey background, even soft lighting, no cast shadows, no text, no labels.
